rea_guided.comparison_to_black_box: No gain in matching steps, workflows, identities, relationships, divergences or unverified steps. REA cost 156.1 s of analysis and produced fewer abstract classes (7 npm / 12 buku) than black-box (8 / 13).
rea_guided.interpretation: The six hints did not translate into different synthesized effects, guards or outputs. The likely bottleneck is either a lossy hint projection or the behavioral synthesizer not consuming the useful relationships; hint volume alone is not evidence of value.

failure_taxonomy.observable: install_alpha and install_beta succeed but leave direct_dependencies, packages, lock_packages, package_count and relationship_count unchanged; reference creates package records and lock entries.
failure_taxonomy.secondary_observable: created_id is absent from the model output while created_pool and version are present.
failure_taxonomy.classification: The records and identities exist in the observed schema, but no mutation effect was selected; this is a synthesis gap, not an IR impossibility demonstrated by this run. Nested dependency edges compound the problem.
failure_taxonomy.unverified: install_missing is unverified because no successful contrast supports an enabling guard; the rejection is not counted as a pass.

failure_taxonomy.observable: tag_count is 0 in the model while the reference has 1; tags, bookmark_count and the bookmark record match.
failure_taxonomy.classification: The existing sum_length-style derived collection mechanism could express a tag count, but the candidate was not selected. This is a candidate/derived-state omission rather than a demonstrated expressiveness limit.
failure_taxonomy.consequence: All four buku workflows inherit the derived-state mismatch and are excluded downstream.

failure_taxonomy.observable: The data-aware notes report reference initial state null versus the program initial state for npm sequences.
failure_taxonomy.classification: Infrastructure caveat discovered after freeze; preserved rather than repaired. It is not the primary semantic divergence because post-action comparisons still expose the missing effects, but it should be eliminated in a new suite version.
